name: outcome_id
description: Opaque EVAL-P11 outcome.id seen on traces, events, or closing spans inside [from_time, to_time).

name: is_closed
description: TRUE when an outcome.closed span or event is observed within the bounded lookback window.

name: open_time
description: Earliest outcome.opened event_time (NULL when no opening event was emitted).

name: close_time
description: Timestamp of the winning outcome.closed record (authority system_of_record > platform > application, then earliest event_time, tie-break event_id asc; NULL when open; ADR-047).

name: outcome_status
description: Terminal outcome.status (succeeded, failed, abandoned, escalated, rejected, denied; NULL when open or unreported).

name: outcome_owner
description: Claimed owning application ID from outcome.owner.

name: outcome_parent_id
description: Optional parent outcome identifier from outcome.parent_id.

name: case_id
description: Earliest non-null bq_eval.case_id across member traces.

name: eval_run_id
description: Earliest non-null bq_eval.eval_run_id across member traces.

name: page_count
description: MAX of page_count across member traces (NULL when unreported).

name: min_model_confidence
description: MIN of model_confidence across all model calls of member traces (default multi-trace safety gate).

name: final_model_confidence
description: model_confidence of the latest model call (by end_time, span_id) across member traces.

name: escalated
description: TRUE when any member trace escalated, an outcome.escalated event exists, or outcome_status = 'escalated'.

name: trace_count
description: Count of member traces carrying this outcome_id in the lookback window (0 when known from events only).

name: trace_ids
description: Ordered JSON array of member trace_id strings (NULL when trace_count = 0, distinct from []).

name: root_error_trace_count
description: Count of member traces whose root_status is ERROR (0 when none).

name: failed_trace_count
description: Count of member traces with app_failed = true (0 when none).

name: rootless_trace_count
description: Count of member traces with has_root_span = false (0 when none).

name: closing_trace_id
description: trace_id of the winning outcome.closed record (NULL when open or closed by a trace-less event).

name: last_span_arrival_time
description: Latest receive_time across spans of member traces (NULL when trace_count = 0).

name: business_unit
description: Business unit resolved from outcome_owner in app_registry else earliest member trace owner.

name: extends_outside_window
description: TRUE when member traces or events exist in [from_time - outcome_lookback_days, to_time + read_margin) outside [from_time, to_time).

name: labels
description: Open-safe registered slice-only attributes JSON object.
